Standing knowledge: an assignment of IP requires a signed written instrument; proposals, 'subject to contract' terms, unsigned drafts, assertions and payments do not by themselves transfer rights.

Reply with ONE JSON object and nothing else:
{"p": <0-100>, "conf": "<LOW|MED|HIGH>", "decisive_gap": "<most important missing item, or none>"}
